senses.gloss: f.(b. h. <cite ref="U01691"><he>שְׂעֹרָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="U01682"><he>שָׂעַר</he></cite> , v. <cite ref="O01293"><he>סָעַר</he></cite>)
barley, barley-corn.—כש׳ the size of a barley-corn.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:8">Kel. XVII, 8</cite> <he>כש׳ שאמרו לא וכ׳</he> where the scholars make the barley-corn the ritual standard measure, neither the large sort is meant nor &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10">Ex. R. s. 10</cite>, end; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00251"><he>שֵׁד</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01643"><he>שְׂעוֹרִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01644"><he>שְׂעוֹרִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 35a:6">Ib. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>מין ש׳</he> a species of barley, v. <cite ref="U01017"><he>שִׁיפוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:6">Ib. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>לא היה יינם … ש׳</he> the wine of Judæa would not get sour (to be used for vinegar) until they put barley into it.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:20">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>גדישין של ש׳</he> stacks of barley.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:7">Peah VI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:5:1">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵇ</cite> bot., a. e., v. <cite ref="P00944"><he>עֲנָבָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
